name: Carmo armchair

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. description: Bornholm coffee table
name: Bornholm coffee table

details.designFeatures: Customise every feature|From designer bed frame to headboard, fabric to finish, Element allows you to create a bed that is tailored to you, your style and your space requirements.|3-step customisation|Simply choose your bed frame, select your preferred headboard style and whether it's mounted to the wall or bed. Finish with a choice of legs and materials. With this intuitive approach, you can create a bedroom that’s beautifully cohesive and completely your own.|Smart storage solutions|Element is designed to help you declutter and stay organised with optional integrated storage. variants.name: Carmo open end sofa, angled, right

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Organic shapes|The Bolzano sofa is made up of organic shapes and curved lines, encouraging togetherness and creating a sense of comfort in the home.|Elegant Silhouette|With a refined, round silhouette, the lines of the Bolzano sofa are clean and minimalistic for a contemporary and streamlined look that will never go out of style.|360° Curve|Complemented by a rounded armrest that continues throughout the back, the Bolzano sofa is crafted with a curved front panel that offers a 360° curve all the way around.|Considered details|The Bolzano sofa is finished with considered detailing, such as a ‘pulled in’ stitching detail on the rear that adds character to the design.|Invisible legs|Complete with discreet, ‘invisible’ legs, the Bolzano sofa has a low and floating appearance.|Superior seating comfort|The Bolzano sofa does not compromise on comfort with the perfect foam to frame ratio for all-day lounging.

description: Aarhus 3-seater sofa
name: Aarhus 3-seater sofa

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus 3 seater sofa evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. With rounded trims mirrored in the leg shape, this is a timeless expression of Scandinavian style.|Circular design principles|Created to last and adapt, the Aarhus 3 seater sofa is built on circular design principles. Every component is designed to be repaired, replaced, or recycled, extending the product’s lifecycle while reducing waste.|Nordic Swan Ecolabel|The Aarhus sofa is certified with the Nordic Swan Ecolabel, meeting some of the most rigorous environmental standards in the world. It evaluates a product’s entire life cycle – from raw materials to production, use, and disposal.|Materially minded|Upholstered in OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics, the Aarhus sofa is built from materials selected for their comfort, durability, and everyday practicality.|Engineered for comfort|The Aarhus sofa has a refined mid-century silhouette created by a solid wooden frame and traditional steel springs that deliver uniform and long-lasting comfort.

description: Imola armchair
name: Imola armchair

details.designFeatures: Craftsmanship|The core of Imola is made of moulded hard foam, enabling us to create unique shapes. The hard foam is then supplemented with another mould of soft foam to make the chair as comfortable as it is beautiful. The chair is then upholstered in your preferred fabric or leather. This is a very difficult and time consuming process that only a few highly trained upholsters are able to do.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|Base options|The chair has two base options - wire legs and a swivel star base. Choose the swivel base to turn the chair around seamlessly or go with the wire legs for a beautiful completion of the design.|Organic shapes|The strict organic shapes combined with the moulded foam offer a unique and outstanding look. The high back gives the chair a voluminous look that underlines the uniqueness of the design while providing great head support.|Inspired by a tennis ball|Henrik Pedersen's inspiration for the chair came from a tennis ball. When you look at the side of the seat you clearly see the same shapes and lines as in the tennis ball while the stitching completes the look. Even the footstool maintains the same design expression.
details.productSpecification: Frame: 70 kg/m3 high resilient moulded foam with steel frame inside|Suspension: Hard foam

name: Vienna dining chair with swivel function

variants.name: Vienna dining chair with swivel function

details.designFeatures: Danish design|With clear notes to the Danish design heritage, the Vienna chair is crafted with delicate stitching that follows the contour of the chair and ensure a true design statement.|An inviting chair|The back is slightly tilted backwards to give you the ultimate seating comfort. With the sloping armrests and soft shape, the chair invites you to stay at the dining table all night.|Endless possibilities|The Vienna chair is available with a swivel base as well as a four leg solution. Combined with the option of all fabrics and leathers, it is possible to create the perfect chair for your home.|Beautiful comfort|The sloping form of the armrest follows the shape of your arm and ensures a great seating comfort. The armrest is not only for comfort; it allows you to place the chair close to the table.|High traffic, no problem|Vienna is developed with input from the technological institute of Denmark and is tested and approved for high traffic areas.

details.designFeatures: Inspired by the Japanese art form of binding|Nawabari was inspired by the Japanese art form of binding with ropes to forge close bonds. ‘Nawa’ means rope in Japanese, and the term “Nawabari” traditionally translates as stretching rope.|Playful design|As organic as it is sculptural, this modern pouffe brings a sense of playfulness to any space.|Plump curves|This art-inspired piece is defined by its unique, plump curves.|120+ colours and materials|The Nawabari pouffe can be customised in a variety of fabrics and colours to suit your space and style.|Two sizes|A footstool, an extra seat, a coffee table... with two sizes to choose from, you can use it for whatever you need.

details.designFeatures: Customise every feature|From designer bed frame to headboard, fabric to finish, Element allows you to create a bed that is tailored to you, your style and your space requirements.|3-step customisation|Simply choose your bed frame, select your preferred headboard style and whether it's mounted to the wall or bed. Finish with a choice of legs and materials. With this intuitive approach, you can create a bedroom that’s beautifully cohesive and completely your own.|Smart storage solutions|Element is designed to help you declutter and stay organised with optional integrated storage. Perfect for modern life, this is a suite of storage beds that delivers on style without sacrificing function.|Redefining Scandinavian design|Whether you're drawn to a minimalist Scandinavian look or a more luxurious metropolitan vibe, Element takes Scandinavian design principles that evoke calm and reimagines them in a customisable way – creating a bedroom that's uniquely tailored to you.|Flexible by design|Element offers flexibility across all budgets, with options that reflect both pared-back minimalism and elevated luxury. With finishes in Natural Oak, Dark Oak, and Ash Grey, plus fabric and leather options to suit a wide range of interiors and lifestyles.

details.designFeatures: Leaf shape|The leaf shaped back underlines Karim Rashid´s dedication to nature. This feature makes the chair stand out as an iconic dining chair.|Leg design|The four pod leg design in different materials is an untraditional construction that gives the chair a refined and unique look. Also available with a wooden frame, the leg designs highlight the natural look of the seat.|A coordinated expression|The chair fits most dining areas, but works especially great with the Ottawa dining table and sideboard.|Customizable comfort|The foam seat is made of high quality moulded foam that allows the curved design to fit your body shape while allowing you to customize the chair in your selected fabric or leather. The chair is also available in a plastic version that offers great comfort and easy maintenance.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

name: Aarhus pouffe

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus pouffe evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. With rounded trims mirrored in the leg shape, this is a timeless expression of Scandinavian style.|Circular design principles|Created to last and adapt, the Aarhus pouffe is built on circular design principles. Every component is designed to be repaired, replaced, or recycled, extending the product’s lifecycle while reducing waste.|Nordic Swan Ecolabel|The Aarhus pouffe is certified with the Nordic Swan Ecolabel, meeting some of the most rigorous environmental standards in the world. It evaluates a product’s entire life cycle – from raw materials to production, use, and disposal.|Materially minded|Upholstered in OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics, the Aarhus pouffe is built from materials selected for their comfort, durability, and everyday practicality.|Engineered for comfort|The Aarhus pouffe has a refined mid-century silhouette created by a solid wooden frame and traditional steel springs that deliver uniform and long-lasting comfort.

details.designFeatures: Organic Shape|With well-defined shapes and soft curves, the Berne sofa boasts an inviting look and feel, transforming your space into a place you'll never want to leave.|Minimalist Look|The Berne sofa is supported by a wooden frame and slim tube-shaped metal legs, allowing for a minimalist look and light, floating expression.|Superior Back Support|Designed with upright positioning and greater seat depth, the Berne sofa provides superior back support for all-day comfort.|Danish In The Details|Berne is finished with stitch detailing on the seat and the back, which not only adds character but is a nice design detail - it helps to prevent wrinkles in the fabric.|Comfort in every size|The excellent seating comfort of Berne is available in several modules that allow you to create your perfectly sized comfort zone.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.
